last_round.quote: SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., March 26, 2025 — ... Voltage Park ... today announced the acquisition of TensorDock, a leading GPU cloud marketplace. ... Jonathon Lei, founder of TensorDock, has moved into the role of General Manager of On-Demand at Voltage Park.

investors: Navigation Fund (Jed McCaleb's nonprofit, funder of Voltage Park)
note: TensorDock was an independently run GPU marketplace (founder Jonathon Lei) until Voltage Park acquired it in March 2025 (deal terms undisclosed); TensorDock continues to operate under its own brand as a GPU marketplace unit. Voltage Park itself is a for-profit subsidiary of the nonprofit Navigation Fund, founded by blockchain billionaire Jed McCaleb (Stellar/Ripple/Mt. Gox co-founder), which donated an estimated $500M worth of Nvidia H100 GPUs to seed it (TechCrunch, Oct 2023) — this is not a conventional VC funding round. In turn, Voltage Park merged with Lightning AI (maker of PyTorch Lightning) in a deal reported by Forbes at a $2.5B valuation, completing in March 2026; the combined company (now operating under the Lightning AI name) reported ARR growing from $18M (2024) to over $500M (as of the March 2026 merger announcement) — that figure is for the whole combined company, not TensorDock specifically. No independent pre-acquisition funding round for TensorDock (seed/Series A, YC, etc.) was found in TechCrunch, Crunchbase-adjacent search, or YC's own company directory.
